I will keep this plot low-cost because it is very small, and I cannot tie up much cash on inputs for just 0.13 hectares. On my groundnut plot, I usually rely more on the little compost I can make at home and family labor, and if I intercrop, I do not want to spend money on fertilizer that may not pay me back. I will plant the seed I can trust and get nearby, weed by hand, and only buy chemicals if there is a bad pest problem, so for this season I will not plan on them.
